items.title: Crown Castle (CCI) Names Next CFO As Sunit Patel And Cathy Piche Retire
items.summary: Crown Castle (NYSE:CCI) announced a series of leadership changes, including planned transitions in its chief financial officer and chief operating officer roles. CFO Sunit Patel plans to retire, with the board naming Kris Hinson as the intended next CFO after Patel steps down. COO Cathy Piche also intends to retire, and Crown Castle has started a search process to identify her successor.
